title: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
excerpt: There was no way I could have known ahead of time just how profoundly Hippocrates would impact my life.
content:
There was no way I could have known ahead of time just how profoundly Hippocrates would impact my life. My stay was wonderful! Realizing the possibilities for true healing that are available there stirred something in me I thought was lost. People who know me say I returned from Hippocrates a different person. But I say “I got my old (young) self back!”

Today I am a full-time pre-med student at the University of Houston, and next years I will be applying to Bastyr University for their naturopathic physicians program.
